subject: How a gun tracks its fire target and fires: the turning-gun target angles, the rate-limited step at the gun's +310h tick element, the node matrices, and the CanFire / FireIfReady chain.
reuses: docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md for the gun record and 00730160 Fire
docs/GUN_CLASS_FAMILY.md for the six classes behind 00CFE0A8
docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_FIELDS.md for the platform record, RestAngles and the Windows firing arcs
docs/TICK_ELEMENT_OVERRIDES.md for the fixed-step tick element at +310h and unit+6F8h/+6FCh
docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md and docs/IN_MISSION_SUBSYSTEM_TICK.md for the vtable[0DCh] world walk

functions.name: BSP_Gun_UpdateBarrelRecoil
functions.notes: Per barrel: barrel+10h becomes (speed != 0); barrel+Ch (DT) accumulates dt and, while at or above 1/120 (00CEF0B8), subtracts 1/120 (00CFDF80) and advances dist/speed against weaponDescriptor+ACh, +B0h and +B4h. dist and speed are the recoil slide and its velocity, not a projectile speed.

functions.name: BSP_GunPlatform_AnglesInTraverseWindow
functions.notes: Walks platform+3Ch for platform+40h records of 14h bytes: +4h MinHorzAngle, +8h MaxHorzAngle, +Ch MinVertAngle, +10h MaxVertAngle, +0h flags. Each bound is widened by 0.008726646 rad (00D08B88) and the horizontal angle is first clamped to +/-pi (00D7A264, 00CE684C). Bit 0 of the flags must be set.

functions.name: BSP_GunPlatform_AnglesInFireWindow
